title: Agentic Q2C: structural recovery and calculation selection in a synthetic nuclear inverse problem
summary: Nuclear interaction calibration must distinguish inadequate functional form from poorly fitted couplings. We test a resident language-model investigator that revises the isovector interaction of a spherical relativistic Hartree model. Continuous optimization fits synthetic binding energies, charge radii, and neutron skins; the investigator selects registered density-dependent and mixed-vector terms.
